Welcome to Module 3!

In this module, you will learn how to **analyse whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data — from start to finish**. Specifically, you will:

- Learn how to derive meaningful **biological conclusions** from raw, paired-end **Illumina WGS data**.
- Understand important steps in **bioinformatic pipelines for WGS data analysis**.
- Obtain a high-level understanding of **important algorithms** used in WGS data analysis.

Module 3 is organised into five "days" of material:

- **Day 1a:** [Quality control and pre-processing of WGS data](3_1a_quality_control.html)
- **Day 1b:** [*De novo* assembly](3_1b_de_novo_assembly.html)
- **Day 2:** [Genome annotation (part I)](3_2_annotation_part1.html)
- **Day 3:** [Genome annotation (part II)](3_3_annotation_part2.html)
- **Day 4:** [Read mapping and variant calling](3_4_read_mapping.html)
- **Day 5:** [Phylogeny construction](3_5_phylogeny.html)

## Optional graded assignments

(Administered via Canvas; points are added to the final exam score.)

- **Quiz 3.1** (0.5 points): covers Module 3 Day 1.
- **Quiz 3.2** (0.5 points): covers Module 3 Days 2–3.
- **Module 3 hand-in assignment** (3 points): covers Days 1–5.
